articles.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces mounting political and economic pressure across India
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces growing political fatigue, rising youth unemployment, and public protests across Indian urban centers. Opposition parties are demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over electoral concerns. Meanwhile, economic distress, declining consumer confidence, and strained foreign relations have intensified pressure on the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party government, exposing widespread public discontent and institutional friction.

articles.title: BJP may drop 30-40% of Uttar Pradesh MLAs ahead of 2027 polls
articles.summary: In the 2022 assembly polls, retained BJP candidates had an 85% strike rate, compared with 77% for those brought in to replace the sitting MLAs. The 2024 Lok Sabha results told a different story: New candidates who replaced sitting MPs won 11 of 16 seats while only 20 of the 46 incumbents won.

articles.title: Opinion: The new Tollywood-Telangana directors are rewriting Telugu cinema
articles.summary: For decades, Tollywood relied on a familiar formula: a hero twice his heroine’s age, an item number, double-meaning dialogue sold as comedy , and two heroines cast purely to fill posters. The formula left the industry in something close to a moral crisis, while issues of struggle, identity, history and culture took a back seat for a long time.

articles.title: Geothermal energy talks in Houston back US-India technology transfer and pilot projects

articles.title: Delhi Police Crime Branch Takes Over Unauthorized Entry Case of CJP Leaders
articles.summary: The Delhi Police Crime Branch has taken over the unauthorized entry case involving Cockroach Janata Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Sourav Das. articles.title: Economist who predicted 2008 crash says India must grow faster to create jobs

articles.summary: Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi announced that the united INDIA bloc will march to the Supreme Court in New Delhi to file a petition against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. During a press conference, Gandhi claimed that two hundred government officials are currently leaking internal information to the opposition movement.

articles.title: Keep candles and newspapers handy: Gujarat’s power crisis deepens, raising fears
articles.summary: Answer: Coal shortages, scorching heat and rising electricity demand. As a result, 12 states across the country could face power cuts. The All India Power Engineers Federation (AIPEF) recently warned that a serious electricity crisis could emerge because of 'low coal stocks' in 12 states, affecting the operation of thermal power plants.

articles.title: Rain forecast for Dussehra in Indore and Ujjain: Alert for 15 MP districts, including
articles.summary: Madhya Pradesh is likely to witness a change in weather over the next three days. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a thunderstorm and rain alert for 14 districts across the Indore, Ujjain, Bhopal and Narmadapuram divisions on October 20, the day of Dussehra. Winds may reach speeds of 30-40 kmph.
articles.title_hi: दशहरा पर इंदौर और उज्जैन में बारिश का अनुमान: एमपी समेत 15 जिलों में अलर्ट

articles.title: Rajasthan temperatures drop below 20°C in over 10 cities: Clear weather likely for four
articles.summary: Rain lashed several districts of Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Sawai Madhopur, Tonk and Ajmer, on Sunday under the influence of a western disturbance, with hail reported in some places, while cloudy skies prevailed in parts of Jodhpur and Nagaur. The weather system reduced sunshine throughout Sunday, keeping temperatures below normal and bringing a slight chill during both the day and night.

articles.summary_hi: पश्चिमी विक्षोभ के प्रभाव के कारण रविवार को जयपुर, सवाई माधोपुर, टोंक और अजमेर सहित राजस्थान के कई जिलों में बारिश हुई, कुछ स्थानों पर ओलावृष्टि हुई, जबकि जोधपुर और नागौर के कुछ हिस्सों में बादल छाए रहे। मौसम प्रणाली के कारण रविवार को पूरे दिन धूप कम रही, जिससे तापमान सामान्य से नीचे रहा और दिन और रात दोनों में हल्की ठंड रही।

articles.title: Older faces proved more successful than newcomers in UP: Replacing 40% of MLAs could
articles.summary: Follow Bhaskar English for latest updates on UP BJP election strategy and potential rebellion. To secure a third consecutive victory in 2027 and address public resentment, the BJP is preparing to bet on new faces. There have been repeated indications that the BJP may adopt the pattern followed in Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Haryana and Assam in Uttar Pradesh.

articles.title_hinglish: yupi men nae cheharon ki tulana men purane chehare adhika saphala sabita hue: 40% vidhayakon ko badala ja saka
articles.summary_hinglish: yupi bijepi ki chunavi rananiti aura sanbhavita bagavata para taja apadeta ke lie bhaskara inglisha ko pholo karen। 2027 men lagatara tisari jita hasila karane aura janata ki narajagi dura karane ke lie bijepi nae cheharon para danva lagane ki taiyari kara rahi hai। bara-bara aise sanketa mila rahe hain ki bijepi gujarat, madhya pradesh, hariyana aura asama ka paitarna uttara pradesha men bhi apana sakati hai.

articles.title: India’s Finance Minister blames easy exits and excess liquidity for equity market's
articles.summary: Excess liquidity in India's equity market has contributed to underperformance and may continue to do so, according to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. "Because of the ease of liquidity, ease of availability, people are even exiting easily" from equities, Sitharaman told CNBC in an exclusive interview on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok on Friday.

articles.title: India’s Birds In The Dark wins big at Busan International Film Festival
articles.summary: In a major moment for independent cinema in India, Shashank Walia’s Birds in the Dark (Hanere De Panchi) has won multiple honours at Busan. Winning the prestigious New Currents Award and the Songwon Vision Audience Award at the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), the film has received prize money totalling 30 million South Korean won.
articles.title_hi: बुसान इंटरनेशनल फिल्म फेस्टिवल में इंडियाज बर्ड्स इन द डार्क ने बड़ी जीत हासिल की

articles.title: National Unity Day: Motorcycle rally flagged off to spread anti-drug message
articles.summary: Throughout the route, the motorcyclists will make scheduled stops at schools, colleges and public places to directly interact with youth and community members. Farooqui stated that carrying educational and motivational material, the riders will deliver lectures and conduct awareness sessions to sensitise the masses to say no to drugs and choose a healthy lifestyle.
articles.title_hi: राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस: नशा विरोधी संदेश फैलाने के लिए मोटरसाइकिल रैली को दिखाई हरी झंडी

articles.title: Tiger Shroff's hand burnt with gunpowder, Eknath Shinde vows action against gangs
articles.summary: Shinde described the incident as serious and vowed strict action against those responsible, warning that no gang or individual would be allowed to revive gang wars in Mumbai. Shinde said five rounds were fired at Tiger Shroff 's BMW as the actor was leaving after playing a football match on Sunday evening.
articles.title_hi: टाइगर श्रॉफ का हाथ बारूद से जला, एकनाथ शिंदे ने गिरोह के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की कसम खाई

articles.title: Gujarat: Contractor booked as 6-year-old bridge found unsafe in Narmada district
articles.summary: The Roads and Buildings Department filed the complaint against Surat-based Royal Infra Engineering Pvt Ltd at Rajpipla police station following directions from Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel, a government release said. The bridge, located on the Rajpipla-Ramgadh (Navagam) road, was constructed at a cost of Rs 10. 71 crore. The department awarded the contract to the firm in 2018-19.
articles.title_hi: गुजरात: नर्मदा जिले में 6 साल पुराना पुल असुरक्षित पाए जाने पर ठेकेदार पर मामला दर्ज किया गया
articles.summary_hi: एक सरकारी विज्ञप्ति में कहा गया है कि सड़क और भवन विभाग ने मुख्यमंत्री भूपेन्द्र पटेल के निर्देश के बाद सूरत स्थित रॉयल इंफ्रा इंजीनियरिंग प्राइवेट लिमिटेड के खिलाफ राजपीपला पुलिस स्टेशन में शिकायत दर्ज की है। राजपीपला-रामगढ़ (नवागाम) रोड पर स्थित इस पुल का निर्माण 10. 71 करोड़ रुपये की लागत से किया गया था। विभाग ने 2018-19 में फर्म को ठेका दे दिया।

articles.title: Release pending incentives to medal-winning athletes: Anurag Thakur to Himachal govt
articles.summary: Expressing concern over the state's sports infrastructure, Thakur said despite availability of resources, several areas still lack essential facilities such as indoor stadiums, synthetic tracks and other sports infrastructure. He called upon the state government to address the shortage of playgrounds and ensure appointment of trained coaches across different sports disciplines.
articles.title_hi: पदक विजेता एथलीटों को लंबित प्रोत्साहन राशि जारी करें: अनुराग ठाकुर ने हिमाचल सरकार से कहा

articles.title: Bihars vanishing Ramleela tradition: Village stages silent as Dussehra celebrations change
articles.summary: AURANGABAD (Bihar), Oct 18 : Once upon a time, as Dussehra approached, villages across Bihar would begin preparing for one of their most cherished cultural traditions Ramleela. Months before the festival, local committees would become active, performers would begin rehearsals and villages (chowraha) squares would gradually turn into open-air theatres where episodes from the Ramayana came alive before enthusiastic audiences.
articles.title_hi: बिहार की लुप्त हो रही रामलीला परंपरा: दशहरा समारोह में बदलाव के साथ गांव के मंचों पर सन्नाटा
articles.summary_hi: औरंगाबाद (बिहार), 18 अक्टूबर: एक समय था, जब दशहरा नजदीक आता था, बिहार भर के गांव अपनी सबसे प्रतिष्ठित सांस्कृतिक परंपराओं में से एक रामलीला की तैयारी शुरू कर देते थे। त्योहार से महीनों पहले, स्थानीय समितियाँ सक्रिय हो जाती थीं, कलाकार रिहर्सल शुरू कर देते थे और गाँव (चौराहा) के चौराहे धीरे-धीरे ओपन-एयर थिएटर में बदल जाते थे जहाँ उत्साही दर्शकों के सामने रामायण के एपिसोड जीवंत हो जाते थे।
articles.title_hinglish: bihara ki lupta ho rahi ramalila paranpar: dashahara samaroha men badalava ke satha ganva ke manchon para sannata
articles.summary_hinglish: aurangabada (bihara), 18 aktubar: eka samaya th, jaba dashahara najadika aata th, bihara bhara ke ganva apani sabase pratishthita sanskritika paranparaon men se eka ramalila ki taiyari shuru kara dete the। tyohara se mahinon pahale, sthaniya samitiyan sakriya ho jati thin, kalakara riharsala shuru kara dete the aura ganva (chauraha) ke chaurahe dhire-dhire opana-eyara thietara men badala jate the jahan utsahi darshakon ke samane ramayana ke episoda jivanta ho jate the।

articles.title: Jammu and Kashmir leaders condemn violent attack on bus in Haryana
articles.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir government and various political parties have unitedly condemned a violent attack on a Srinagar-bound bus in Haryana. Officials are demanding strict action against those responsible for the incident. According to reports, three rounds were fired at the actor’s BMW while he was returning home after a football session. Although the gunfire triggered panic, Tiger Shroff escaped unhurt and is safe. However, the actor’s driver sustained injuries during the incident and was rushed to Nanavati Hospital.

articles.title: Get a tech list to tick: Can India achieve true self-reliance without an evidence-based
articles.summary: India aims to achieve self-reliance by systematically identifying critical technologies for its national strategy. The government has established initiatives, such as the Anusandhan National Research Foundation, to drive research and development. A clear list of vital technologies will help prioritize investments and reduce dependency on foreign entities. Strategic instruments can then be directed toward fostering domestic capabilities in specified sectors.

articles.title: Neemuch Police Arrest Four Members of Interstate Cyber Fraud Gang
articles.summary: Police in Neemuch arrested four suspects belonging to an interstate cyber fraud ring that promised fake stock tips to victims. Authorities seized sixty two automated teller machine cards, cheque books, mobile phones, and a laptop during the operation. Officers also recovered over fifty one thousand rupees. The crackdown aims to curb financial crimes across state borders.

articles.summary_hi: हाल ही में, राज्य सरकार ने स्थानीय अर्थव्यवस्था त्वरक कार्यक्रम (एलईएपी) के तहत, बेंगलुरु से परे कर्नाटक की प्रौद्योगिकी वृद्धि का विस्तार करने के उद्देश्य से हुबली और बेलगावी में प्रत्येक में 10,000 वर्ग फुट के जीटीसी की स्थापना को मंजूरी दी। आईटी मंत्री प्रियांक खड़गे ने कहा कि प्लग-एंड-प्ले सुविधाओं के साथ जीटीसी का उद्देश्य स्थानीय स्तर पर बुनियादी ढांचे और अवसरों के साथ प्रौद्योगिकी प्रतिभा, स्टार्टअप और उद्यमिता प्रदान करना है।
articles.title_hinglish: uttari karnataka kshetra men do vaishvika takaniki kendra khulenge
articles.summary_hinglish: hala hi men, rajya sarakara ne sthaniya arthavyavastha tvaraka karyakrama (elaeeepi) ke tahat, bengaluru se pare karnataka ki praudyogiki vriddhi ka vistara karane ke uddeshya se hubali aura belagavi men pratyeka men 10,000 varga phuta ke jitisi ki sthapana ko manjuri di। aaeeti mantri priyanka khadage ne kaha ki plaga-enda-ple suvidhaon ke satha jitisi ka uddeshya sthaniya stara para buniyadi dhanche aura avasaron ke satha praudyogiki pratibh, startaapa aura udyamita pradana karana hai।

articles.title: International Wildlife Racket Hits Odisha: STF Clueless as Orangutan Smuggling
articles.summary: The prime suspect and alleged mastermind behind the operation, Jayanta Maiti, alongside his son, remains at large. Efforts by the STF to apprehend the duo or secure concrete evidence against them have proven futile. While interrogations were conducted with employees at Maiti’s hotel and his family members, investigators failed to gather actionable leads.
articles.title_hi: ओडिशा में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय वन्यजीव रैकेट का हमला: एसटीएफ को ओरंगुटान की तस्करी का कोई सुराग नहीं मिला
articles.summary_hi: ऑपरेशन के पीछे मुख्य संदिग्ध और कथित मास्टरमाइंड, जयंत मैती, अपने बेटे के साथ, बड़े पैमाने पर बने हुए हैं। दोनों को पकड़ने या उनके खिलाफ ठोस सबूत हासिल करने के एसटीएफ के प्रयास निरर्थक साबित हुए हैं। जबकि मैती के होटल के कर्मचारियों और उनके परिवार के सदस्यों से पूछताछ की गई, जांचकर्ता कार्रवाई योग्य सुराग जुटाने में विफल रहे।
articles.title_hinglish: odisha men antarrashtriya vanyajiva raiketa ka hamal: esatiepha ko orangutana ki taskari ka koee suraga nahin mila
articles.summary_hinglish: ऑpareshana ke pichhe mukhya sandigdha aura kathita mastaramaind, jayanta maiti, apane bete ke sath, badaे paimane para bane hue hain। donon ko pakadane ya unake khilapha thosa sabuta hasila karane ke esatiepha ke prayasa nirarthaka sabita hue hain। jabaki maiti ke hotala ke karmachariyon aura unake parivara ke sadasyon se puchhatachha ki gaee, janchakarta karravaee yogya suraga jutane men viphala rahe।
